description: Reports the number of requests still permitted before RequestBudgetExceeded will be raised, so callers (e.g. run_acquisition) can decide to stop issuing new work proactively rather than hitting the exception.
docstring:
Return remaining request budget.

Returns:
    The number of further acquire() calls that will succeed before the budget is exhausted. Never negative.
postconditions: Decreases by exactly 1 after each successful acquire() call and is otherwise unaffected by observe_response

edge_cases.input: Called immediately after construction, before any acquire()
Called after the budget has been fully consumed

unit_tests.name: test_decrements_per_acquire
unit_tests.description: After 3 successful acquire() calls on a budget of 100, remaining_budget() is 97.

unit_tests.name: test_floors_at_zero
unit_tests.description: After the budget is exhausted, remaining_budget() stays at 0 rather than going negative.
